capabilities: Preview the active note with WeChat-ready article themes in the sidebar
Synchronize scrolling between the editor and the preview
Copy the article body as rich text for pasting into WeChat drafts
Embed local and remote images as Base64 during copy without an image host
Convert math and Mermaid diagrams to images for WeChat compatibility
disambiguation: Not a one-click WeChat publisher; it copies formatted rich text that you paste into the WeChat draft editor yourself.
extras: No WeChat AppID, AppSecret, account configuration, telemetry, or automatic draft submission; conversion happens in memory and never writes Base64 data back into notes. Installable via BRAT for beta testing.
intentEvidence: The article theme library and some compatibility strategies are adapted from the MIT-licensed Raphael Publish.
problem: Publishing Markdown to the WeChat Official Account editor means re-styling by hand and finding an image host, since pasted Markdown loses formatting and local image paths don't transfer.

relations.evidence: The article theme library and some compatibility strategies are adapted from the MIT-licensed Raphael Publish.
The README structure and installation flow were inspired by Wechat Converter.

summary: WeChat publishing preview that renders notes with WeChat-ready themes, syncs scrolling between editor and preview, and copies rich text with images embedded as Base64.
